title: AI automation, transformation and optimisation — LucrumTech
description: Most AI projects never leave the pilot. We build AI automation, transformation and optimisation into the systems you already run — and own it in production.
h1: AI that makes it into production.
lede: Most AI projects die between the demo and the deployment. Something impressive gets built, everyone agrees it's the future, and a year later nothing is running in the business. The technology was rarely the problem.
lede2: We build AI into the systems you already run, and stay accountable for it once it's live. Same answer as everything else we do: one team, owning it until it works.

gap.h2: A demo proves it can work. Production proves it does.
gap.body: A pilot runs on clean data, a willing team and no deadline. Production has none of those. The model meets real documents, real edge cases, and real people who already have a job to do — and somewhere in there the project stops being anyone's responsibility.
gap.strong: That gap isn't a technology problem. It's an ownership problem.

build.h2: Three things, all of them shipped before.

blocks.p: The manual steps in a workflow: reading documents, extracting data, moving it between systems.
items: Document parsing and data extraction at volume
Call and meeting transcription into structured records
Routing and triage inside existing workflows

blocks.p: Changing how a process works, not just making the current version faster.
items: Copilots embedded where the work actually happens
Rebuilding a process around what AI makes possible

blocks.p: Processes you already run, made measurably better.
items: Cost and latency tuning on existing AI systems
Replacing brittle rules with models where it pays
Taking a stalled pilot the rest of the way

proof.h2: Days to hours. In production. Still running.
proof.body: Insurance case processing ran on manual document handling and took days. We built a platform that parses claim PDFs, transcribes calls, extracts structured data and generates the reports. Processing dropped from days to hours.

scope.h2: We'll tell you when AI isn't the answer.
scope.body: Plenty of problems labelled "AI" turn out to be data problems, process problems or reporting problems, where a model would add cost and uncertainty and little else. If that's what we find, we'll say so — the same way we would about any product we didn't think was worth building.
